Build terminal applications with R

termr is an R framework for interactive, keyboard-driven terminal user interfaces. Compose applications from widgets and layouts, handle typed events, and inspect data in a full-screen terminal interface.

Installation

termr requires R 4.1 or newer and is not currently published on CRAN. R-universe provides an R package repository that works with the standard install.packages() function. Install termr and its dependencies with:

install.packages(
  "termr",
  repos = c(
    "https://menshikovs.r-universe.dev",
    "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  )
)

For the development version, install remotes and then install from GitHub:

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("menshikovs/termr")

The package declares its runtime imports in DESCRIPTION; its installation command installs those package dependencies. No package-specific SystemRequirements are declared.
